config.hyperspace_wormholes.title: Hyperspace & Wormholes Settings
config.hyperspace_wormholes.server: On a server, the server's own settings file is used.
config.hyperspace_wormholes.hoopaPity.ti: Determines the total amount of distortions required to enter before you are guaranteed to find Hoopa. 0 turns this off.
config.hyperspace_wormholes.necrozmaPity: Total White Wormholes for Necrozma Boss
Determines the total amount of white wormholes required to enter before you are guaranteed to find Necrozma. 0 turns this off.
config.hyperspace_wormholes.hardMode.tip: Hard Mode increases the difficulty of the bosses by raising their levels and increasing their stats. Hard Mode is available after defeating that boss once with this option off.
config.hyperspace_wormholes.baseShiny.ti: Determines the base chance of finding a shiny Pokémon inside a wormhole, as a percentage. Default 1.
config.hyperspace_wormholes.shinyPerRing: Determines the increased chance of shiny Pokémon added per ring on a wormhole. 1 is normal, 2 is double, 0 means rings add nothing.
config.hyperspace_wormholes.griefing.tip: Enable/Disable lightning and Pokémon's moves from destroying Data Monitors.
config.hyperspace_wormholes.maxDistortio: Lets you increase or decrease the amount of distortions around per player.
config.hyperspace_wormholes.stars.tip: Modify the weight of distortion ratings.
config.hyperspace_wormholes.donuts.tip: How strong each Flavor Power from a donut is. 1 is normal, 2 is twice as strong, 0 turns that power off.
config.hyperspace_wormholes.sparkling.ti: Sparkling Power gives a Hyperspace trip extra shiny rolls. 2 gives twice as many extra rolls.
config.hyperspace_wormholes.alpha.tip: Alpha Power makes Alpha Pokémon more common in Hyperspace. 2 doubles the bonus.
config.hyperspace_wormholes.humungo.tip: Humungo Power makes Pokémon in Hyperspace spawn larger. 2 doubles the size increase.
config.hyperspace_wormholes.teensy.tip: Teensy Power makes Pokémon in Hyperspace spawn smaller. 2 doubles the size decrease.
config.hyperspace_wormholes.item.tip: Item Power gives Floating Poké Balls a chance to drop Golden Floating Poké Ball loot. 2 doubles that chance.
config.hyperspace_wormholes.bigHaul.tip: Big Haul adds extra items to every Floating Poké Ball you pop. 2 doubles the extra items.
config.hyperspace_wormholes.encounter.ti: Encounter Power raises how many Pokémon stay around you in Hyperspace. 2 doubles the extra Pokémon.
config.hyperspace_wormholes.catching.tip: Catching Power gives a failed Poké Ball throw in Hyperspace a chance to catch anyway. 2 doubles that chance.
